meta.name: ai-content-pipeline
meta.description: Build multi-step AI content creation pipelines combining image, video, audio, and text. Workflow examples: generate image -> animate -> add voiceover -> merge with music. Tools: FLUX, Veo, Kokoro TTS, OmniHuman, media merger, upscaling. Use for: YouTube videos, social media content, marketing materials, automated content. Triggers: content pipeline, ai workflow, content creation, multi-step ai, content automation, ai video workflow, generate and edit, ai content factory, automated content creation, ai production pipeline, media pipeline, content at scale

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多步流水线自动生成含图文音视频的内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要批量制作含配音和动画的视频内容
copy.tagline_en: Automate multi-step content creation with images, video, audio, and text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to batch-produce videos with voiceover and animation

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过命令行工具 `belt` 执行多步骤 AI 内容创作流程，例如生成图片、动画、配音、合并视频等，产出 YouTube 短视频、社交媒体内容或营销材料。
howto.when: 当你提到“内容管道”、“AI 工作流”、“多步骤 AI”等关键词，或要求创建自动化内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个从脚本到配音再到头像视频的管道。
say.note: Claude 会生成脚本、语音和头像视频。

say.text: 用 FLUX 生成一张未来城市图片，然后用 Wan 动画化。
say.note: Claude 会依次执行图片生成和动画步骤。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can execute multi-step AI content creation pipelines via the `belt` CLI, combining image, video, audio, and text generation to produce YouTube shorts, social media content, or marketing materials.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "content pipeline", "AI workflow", "multi-step AI", or ask to create automated content.

say_en.text: Create a pipeline from script to voiceover to avatar video.
say_en.note: Claude will generate script, speech, and talking head video.

say_en.text: Generate a futuristic city image with FLUX, then animate it with Wan.
say_en.note: Claude will run image generation then animation.
